title: plugin-email: the email template context has no deployment base URL, so a template cannot render a clickable record link
body:
director#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV5sBSzCYNEDgpYLJw
Ruled: 6573566446 · letter A · 2026-11-02T09:26Z

**Filing-gate category: ② maintainer decision** (a capability the email template context does not offer; the choice of carrier is the platform's).

## What is missing

An email rendered from a declared `emailTemplates` entry (e.g. by a flow `notify` node with `template` + `templateData`) gets a default template context that holds `appName` only (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/capability-arg.ts`: `OS_APP_NAME` > `config.email.appName` > `config.email.defaultTemplateContext.appName` > …). There is no key for the URL the deployment is served at, and `config.email.defaultTemplateContext` has no env carrier, so a metadata-only app cannot put one there per deployment. `OS_BASE_URL` / `OS_AUTH_URL` are already read by `serve` and by service-automation (connector OAuth redirect), but they never reach the template context.

Result: a template can render a record path (`/srm_quality_issue/<id>`) but not a link a recipient can click from their mail client.

## Business reason

hotsrm (supplier relationship management on ObjectStack) now emails supplier portal users directly: new corrective-action requests, returned/overdue ones, certificate expiry, performance published, application results (hotsrm v0.6 U6). Each email is meant to carry a link and no content (amounts, accounts, scores stay in the app). Without a base URL the email can only say "sign in to the portal and open <number>", which works but costs every external recipient a manual search. The in-app inbox entry links correctly through `sourceObject` / `sourceId`; only email is affected. Any app that sends record notifications by email has the same gap.

## Who acts

A plugin-email maintainer decides whether to expose the deployment URL to templates (for example a `baseUrl` key resolved from `OS_BASE_URL`, or an env carrier for `defaultTemplateContext`). hotsrm would then switch its 21 supplier templates to `{{baseUrl}}{{path}}`; until then it keeps the "sign in and open <number>" wording (hotsrm docs/design/07-delivery-plan.md §6.3 PF20).

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue` searches, 2026-11-02: `defaultTemplateContext` → 6 hits, all closed and about other keys (#5448 appName precedence, #5307 / #22748 / #5447 schema carriers); `OS_BASE_URL email` → 5 hits, none about template context; `email template base url` → 199 and `email deep link` → 150, first pages unrelated (QA runs, sweeps, ADR epics). No open or closed issue asks for a base URL in the email template context.
